name: Unlimited Cash Rewards Credit Card
balance_transfer_fee: 3% for the first 60 days of account opening; 5% after
penalty_apr: Up to 29.99%, based on your creditworthiness
penalty_apr_trigger: Making a late payment; applies indefinitely once triggered
pay_over_time_fee: Monthly fee up to 1.72% of the purchase amount assigned to a BofA Custom Pay Plan

welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $1,000 in purchases within the first 90 days of account opening

verdict.text: 1.5% ongoing is average; Customized Cash earns more if you'll manage it

earn_note: A flat 1.5% on everything, with no caps, no categories, and no elevated first-year rate. Enrolled BofA Rewards members get a 10–75% bonus on top of that depending on combined deposit/investment balance, which is where this card actually gets interesting: at the Premier tier the effective rate is 2.62%.

redemption_options.method: Deposit to a Bank of America checking or savings account

points.note: Straightforward flat-rate cash back with no minimum redemption and no expiration while the account stays open.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer currency: straight cash back, not a points program.

insurance.detail: Not responsible for fraudulent transactions once reported

protection_note: Bank of America's purchase/travel protection suite is only advertised on the Premium Rewards cards; it isn't published for this card despite the shared Visa Signature network tier.
rental_note: No auto rental coverage documented publicly for this card as of this writing.

services.name: $250 welcome bonus
services.detail: One-time $250 cash bonus after $1,000 in purchases within the first 90 days. Bank of America is running this as a limited-time offer, up from the standing $200.

services.name: Intro balance transfer fee
services.detail: 3% for the first 60 days the account is open, then 5% on all future transfers.

services.name: BofA Rewards bonus
services.detail: 10% (Member, under $30k), 25% (Preferred Plus, $30k), 50% (Preferred Honors, $100k), or 75% (Premier, $1M) bonus on cash back earned, set by your three-month average combined Bank of America and Merrill balance. Needs a BofA personal checking account.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns cash back on their spend (into your account)

additional_cards.note: No cost to add: flat-rate earning means there's no category math to coordinate across users.

timeline.text: Preferred Rewards became BofA Rewards. The tiers were renamed (Gold and Platinum folded into Preferred Plus, Platinum Honors became Preferred Honors, Diamond became Premier) and existing members moved over automatically. The 25–75% card bonus survived the change and a 10% Member tier was added below it, so nobody earning a bonus before is earning less now. Preferred Honors and Premier also picked up subscription reimbursement worth up to $96 and $180 a year.
